Kategori dan spesifikasi perkhidmatan bas ekspres

2. (1) Hendaklah ada dua kategori perkhidmatan bas ekspres seperti
yang berikut:

(a) perkhidmatan bas ekspres kategori ekonomi; dan

(b) perkhidmatan bas ekspres kategori eksekutif.

(2) Spesifikasi perkhidmatan bas ekspres kategori ekonomi dan kategori
eksekutif hendaklah mengikut spesifikasi sebagaimana yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual,
masing-masing.

LAND PUBLIC TRANSPORT ACT 2010

LAND PUBLIC TRANSPORT (PRESCRIPTION OF CATEGORY OF
EXPRESS BUS SERVICES) REGULATIONS 2021

IN exercise of the powers conferred by paragraph 252(1) (u), (tr) , and
subsection 252(2) Land Public Transport Act 2010 [ Act 715 ], the Minister makes the
following regulations:

Citation
1. These regulations may be cited as the Land Public Transport
(Prescription of Category of Express Bus Services) Regulations 2021.

Category and specification of express bus services
2. (1) There shall be two categories of express bus services as follows:

(a) economy express bus category; and

(b) executive express bus category.

(2) Specifications of category of economy and executive express bus services
shall be in accordance specification as specified in the Schedule, respectively.
